Article 3 (Award for Meritorious Service)
(1) An award for meritorious service shall be conferred upon units or military personnel, civilian military employees, members of reserve forces, and persons belonging to the Ministry of National Defense (including agencies, directly subordinate institutions and directly subordinate units thereof; hereinafter the same shall apply in this paragraph) who have rendered outstanding meritorious service in military duties. Where the recipient is a unit, the commendation shall be made by presenting a unit citation; where the recipient is military personnel, a civilian military employee, a member of reserve forces, or a person belonging to the Ministry of National Defense, it shall be made by presenting an individual citation.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the Minister of National Defense may also commend public officials and civilians who have rendered outstanding meritorious service in military duties by presenting individual citations.
